patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image with central text overlay, followed by content sections that alternate between white and a distinct light teal background.
A sophisticated script font is used for the logo and select display elements, contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for headings, body text, and navigation.
A vibrant, high-quality food photography palette is grounded by a clean white background, dark text, and a distinctive light teal/green accent color for section backgrounds and branding.

The primary navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and losing its top-level contact information bar, then sticking to the top of the viewport. The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content.
Feature sections use a grid of three or four cards, each with a small icon or image and a concise description, presented on a light background.

technique_notes: To achieve the sticky navigation, use a scroll-triggered event to apply a class that reduces the element's height, font size, and removes a top bar, while setting its position to fixed. The hero image parallax can be created by setting the background-attachment to fixed or by using a JavaScript-based solution (e.g., framer-motion or a custom CSS keyframe animation) that adjusts the background position relative to the scroll position.

Content sections are structured with generous vertical padding, using alternating background colors to visually separate them. High-quality, full-bleed photography is used extensively to convey product appeal.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant sans-serif hero heading (~3x body) with a script display font for the logo, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and uppercase navigation labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and some image containers, otherwise sharp corners for most structural elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding in hero and main content sections, and a slightly denser layout for feature grids and the footer.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a light teal/green accent color, combined with exceptionally high-quality and vibrant food photography, elevates it beyond a generic template. The elegant script logo and display font also add a unique, sophisticated touch.
